title: What happens if you turn your wheel while stopped?
hook: Stop dry steering your front tires.

script.narration: Stop dry steering your front tires.
script.visual_search: driver turning steering wheel while car is parked

script.narration: Turning your steering wheel while the car is completely stationary forces the heavy weight of the vehicle to grind against the rubber, wearing out your steering components fast.
script.visual_search: close up of car tire turning on asphalt

script.narration: Always roll forward just an inch before turning.
script.visual_search: car moving forward slowly on street

description: Learn why turning your steering wheel while your car is parked causes premature wear and tear on your suspension and tires. Master essential driving habits in under 60 seconds with Learn in 60 Seconds.
